description: This Java class 'ProductionRun' models and manages production run entities within the manufacturing module of an OFBiz-based system. It provides methods for retrieving, updating, and calculating scheduling details for production runs, including related routing tasks and components.

classes.name: ProductionRun
classes.description: Represents and manages a manufacturing production run, including scheduling, related tasks, components, and associated product data.

methods.name: ProductionRun
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a ProductionRun object by loading data from the database based on productionRunId.

methods.name: exist
methods.description: Checks if the production run exists.

methods.name: getGenericValue
methods.description: Returns the underlying GenericValue representing the production run.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores updates to the production run and related entities in the database.

methods.name: getProductProduced
methods.description: Retrieves the product associated with the production run, along with its estimated quantity.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity to produce for the production run.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets a new quantity to produce and updates related component quantities.

methods.name: getEstimatedStartDate
methods.description: Returns the estimated start date of the production run.

methods.name: setEstimatedStartDate
methods.description: Sets the estimated start date.

methods.name: getEstimatedCompletionDate
methods.description: Returns the estimated completion date, recalculating if needed.

methods.name: setEstimatedCompletionDate
methods.description: Sets the estimated completion date directly.

methods.name: recalculateEstimatedCompletionDate
methods.description: Recalculates the estimated completion date based on routing tasks and start date.

methods.name: recalculateEstimatedCompletionDate
methods.description: Recalculates the estimated completion date from the start date and routing tasks.

methods.name: getProductionRunName
methods.description: Returns the name of the production run.

methods.name: setProductionRunName
methods.description: Sets the name of the production run.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the production run.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description.

methods.name: getCurrentStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the production run.

methods.name: getProductionRunComponents
methods.description: Returns the list of components for the production run.

methods.name: getProductionRunRoutingTasks
methods.description: Returns the list of routing tasks for the production run.

methods.name: getLastProductionRunRoutingTask
methods.description: Returns the last routing task based on priority.

methods.name: clearRoutingTasksList
methods.description: Clears the cached list of routing tasks to force reloading.

methods.name: getEstimatedTaskTime
methods.description: Calculates estimated time for a routing task, possibly via a custom service.

methods.name: isUpdateCompletionDate
methods.description: Indicates if the completion date needs to be recalculated.
